message: さっちんのラブラブ大作戦５

name: Sacchin
message: 「Long-handled pruning shears are way too plain~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Maybe I should've gone with something... with a little more impact...」

name: Sacchin
message: 「You know, like this~. Wrapped in nothing but a ribbon~ over your bare skin~, you should've snuck into Synn-kun's futon~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「L-L-Like hell I could do that!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Oh, right~. Nana-chan, did you put a card with the present~?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「A letter? What's that?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「You gotta attach a card that says 'I love you'~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「L-Like I could do something that embarrassing!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「No good~. You forgot the most important part~. The card was crucial~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It is!? Wait, tell me that kind of stuff beforehand!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「It's common sense for a maiden, so I thought you'd know~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I'm disqualified as a maiden!?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「You're hopeless~, Nana-chan.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Don't call me hopeless!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Besides, this kind of thing feels unnatural for me. We should take more time to nurture our love--」

name: Sacchin
message: 「It would've been nice if Synn-kun and Nana-chan were stranded all alone on a desert island~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Auu.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「If it's come to this, there's no choice but to use force~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「U-Use force!?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Steal Synn-kun's chastity~. That'll make any guy fall head over heels~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「M-Me!? W-W-Wait a second, or rather, isn't that backwards!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Then~, at the very least, you've gotta steal his lips~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「T-That kind of thing is, well, how do I put it, someday, when the mood between us gets right.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「I wonder when 'someday' actually is, huh.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ugh.」
